description: MongoDB 7+ document database architecture: Aggregation Pipelines, compound and multikey indices, multi-document ACID transactions, schema design patterns, and sharding partition keys.
instructionsMarkdown:
# MongoDB 7+ Document Architecture & Aggregation Pipelines

Architect high-scale document databases in MongoDB adhering to schema design patterns and ESR indexing.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Index composite queries according to the **Equality, Sort, Range (ESR)** rule.
- Enforce schema integrity and data validation rules using native MongoDB `$jsonSchema`.
- Prevent unbounded document growth by utilizing bucket and subset document patterns.
- Enclose multi-collection atomic mutations within multi-document ACID sessions.
